note: First-floor picture gallery of the Maison de Couture (B62), above the atelier: deep navy walls with white mouldings, black-and-white chequered marble floor, gilt-framed fashion portraits. LANDMARK: the enormous gilt portrait of a lady in a ball gown. Camera faces north: the curved white staircase at the right (east, above the atelier's staircase) goes DOWN to the atelier; the tall glazed double doors in the back wall open onto the roof-terrace garden (zoom). The mature word virilité appears only as museum wall text on the blank brass plaque at the left. Feminine nouns left of x=900, masculine right.
